page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with no marginal notes and no footnotes. Running head "CAPVT XI." at the top, page number "47" at the top right. No catchword or signature.

main_text.p: 𝒬Quintum clima incipit etiam ab oriente in re-gionibus Gog & Magog, deinde transit per partem septentrionalem Chorassen, vbi ciuitates sunt Ale-rez, quod est emporium, Chengebet, Chobarizmue, Aftualno, Alicesce, Alkatabinde, Altabigen, diæce-sis Armeniæ, Barcaha, Nesui, Sciassen[?], Ardon & Chalat: vaditque per regiones Romanorum super Charsana, Cara, & Romam magnam: deinde trā-sit per littora maris Alsemi, id est Syriaci, a parte septentrionis, postea per regiones Hispanorum ince-dit, donec perueniat ad mare occidentale.

Sextū clima incipit ab oriente & trāsit regiones Gog & Magog, & Alazoh[?], fecatq; medium mare Iurgem usq; ad regiones Romanorum, & trāsit per Iuren, Menese, Eradia, Constatinopolim, & regiones Burgen, & peruenit ad mare occidentale.

Septimum clima incipit ab oriente, & a parte septetrionali regionis Gog trāsit per regiones Tur-cia, & littora Iurgen a parte septetrionis: postea secat mare Romanorū, & trāsit per regiones Burgen & Sclauorū, atq; sic peruenit ad mare occidentale.

Quod autem est post hoc clima usque ad complementum loci habitabilis, quantum nos nouimus, incipit ab oriente in regionibus Gog, deinde transit per regiones Alleceti & Abmugor, & terra Turcia: postea vadit per regiones Alahin, deinde per Tyr, postea per Fusen, deinde per Sclauos, donec per-veniat ad mare occidentale.

page.notes: Initial Q of "Quintum" and "Quod" are large decorative capitals, joined to the first word. "Sciassen" is printed with a double-s ligature; read as ss. "Alazoh" has a superscript mark over the z that is hard to read. The word "Abmugor" has an ornamental initial A. Hyphens at line ends are printed and kept.
